title: Hack4Campus 24-Hour Hackathon
description: Build a solution for a real campus problem in teams of 3–4. Mentors from industry, free meals, and prizes for the top three teams.

title: Intro to Machine Learning Workshop
description: A hands-on session covering regression, classification and a first model in Python. Bring a laptop with Python installed.

title: Spandan Annual Cultural Fest
description: Dance, music, drama and stand-up from every department. Doors open at 3:30 PM.

title: Inter-Department Cricket League
description: Knockout T10 matches across all departments. Spectator registration is open; teams register through the sports office.

title: Career Talk: Cracking Product Roles
description: Two alumni product managers share how they prepared, what interviews look like, and answer your questions.

title: Photography Walk & Editing Basics
description: Shoot the campus at sunrise, then learn quick editing techniques. Phone cameras are welcome.

title: Open Mic Night
description: Poetry, music, comedy or just listening. Sign up to perform on the spot.

title: Web Development Bootcamp
description: A full-day build session: HTML, CSS and JavaScript. You leave with a deployed portfolio page.

title: Blood Donation Camp
description: Donate and save lives. Free health check-up for every donor, refreshments included.

title: Inter-College Quiz Championship
description: Teams of two compete across general knowledge, tech, sports and pop culture.

title: Robotics: Build Your First Line Follower
description: Assemble and program a line-following robot. Kits are provided.

title: Morning Yoga & Mindfulness
description: A beginner-friendly session to help you de-stress before the semester gets busy.
